purpose: Blind screening QA of previously unhighlighted Zaporizhzhia alert episodes; not a historical backfill and not a canonical repair.

methodology.canonical_definition: Use the existing Zaporizhzhia frozen denominator and current explosion methodology. Strict requires exact-city evidence, confirmed aerial-war context, one concrete canonical alert episode, and event timing inside that episode or an explicit source statement that the event occurred during it. Publication time is not substituted for event time. Air-defense activity alone is not explosion evidence.
methodology.blind_selection: Sampling was completed before content review. No message keyword, source availability, suspicion score or candidate-generator output influenced which 50 episodes were selected.
methodology.review_search: For each sampled episode, broad independent searches covered indexed public Telegram archives, official police/OVA reporting, Suspilne Zaporizhzhia, Ukrinform and other indexed national/local media. Searches used explosion wording and obvious variants but classification remained under the canonical strict rule.
methodology.same_date_and_boundary_controls: Evidence was matched to episode_id/time window, not merely calendar date. Same-date multiple alerts, cross-midnight episodes, post-episode reporting and publication-time/event-time differences were checked explicitly.

intended_definition: not in historical explosion review/candidate signal set
not in PPO candidate/pilot set as far as reconstructible from repository artifacts
not among the 51 manually checked gap-audit source/candidate records
not among the 13 already confirmed strict misses
not among the 4 already known needs_review cases
selection_universe.limitation: The repository does not preserve a literal complete episode-level list for all 28 PPO candidate messages. The audit therefore excluded every PPO-linked episode directly materialized in the pilot/gap artifacts and conservatively excluded all denominator episodes on the preserved notable rejected-lead dates. This is the closest reproducible repository-based equivalent; it likely narrows the dark-zone universe, but zero residual overlap with unrecoverable rejected PPO candidates cannot be proven.

sampling.method: Proportional stratified random sample by alert_start_date_kyiv calendar quarter. Integer quotas use floor plus largest remainder; within each quarter episodes were sorted by UTC start then Fisher-Yates shuffled using one deterministic seeded PRNG stream.

source_evidence.relevant_evidence_text: Police confirm a Shahed attack on Zaporizhzhia with multiple city impacts while an air alert was active.

sampled_episodes.event_time_interpretation: The alert was active 19:42:55-21:04:58 Europe/Kyiv. Contemporaneous exact-city messages at 19:51, 19:55 and 20:02 explicitly report an explosion, a UAV impact in the city and repeated explosions, all inside the episode. The later police report corroborates the aerial-war context and city impacts; its publication time is not used as event time.
sampled_episodes.explanation: Exact-city explosion wording + explicit UAV impact + confirmed aerial-war context + contemporaneous event times inside one canonical alert episode satisfy the current strict methodology.
sampled_episodes.prior_candidate_overlap_assessment: No overlap with the materialized PPO pilot positive/review IDs, current frozen-period review/candidate IDs, or the 51-message gap-audit register used to construct the dark-zone universe.

summary.ppo_overlap_caveat: True against the repository-materialized/reconstructible PPO candidate set. Because the full rejected PPO candidate list is not preserved, absolute non-membership in every unrecoverable PPO candidate cannot be proven.
summary.operational_screening_interpretation: 1/50 confirmed strict misses: ambiguous under the pre-specified QA thresholds; a second independent blind sample would be warranted before making a stronger completeness claim. This run intentionally stops at 50.
summary.answer: Yes. A strict explosion miss was found in the blind dark-zone sample: 7c008970817e8d13ae402670 on 2026-06-16.

limitations: No full raw historical Zaporizhzhia Telegram export is stored in the repository; public/indexed historical search is not exhaustive.
A negative verdict means no qualifying evidence was found after broad review, not proof that no explosion occurred.
The complete original PPO candidate-message inventory is not recoverable at episode level from repository artifacts; conservative exclusions were used as documented.
Search-engine snippets can misdate or decontextualize Telegram/archive material; suspect hits were opened in source context before classification.
This is an operational QA screening sample, not a statistical population estimate and not a canonical numerator repair.
